atoms.text: This picture shows three different kinds of birds. The pink birds are called flamingos. The birds in the top right corner are emperor penguins and the black birds at the bottom are ostriches.
atoms.sound: ssml: This picture shows three different kinds of birds. The pink birds are called flamingos. The birds in the top right corner are emperor penguins, and the black birds at the bottom are ostriches.

atoms.text: Even though all three of these animals are birds, only the flamingos are able to fly. Flamingos can also swim but, due to their large wings, they are better known for excellent flying skills. In fact, they can even fly very long distances. Emperor penguins can’t fly, but they are excellent swimmers. Ostriches can neither fly nor swim, but they are very fast runners due to their strong, long legs. Another interesting fact is that while emperor penguins are carnivorous, flamingos and ostriches are omnivorous.

hint.text:
Carnivores: Carnivorous animals only eat meat.

Omnivores: Omnivorous animals eat both meat and plants.

atoms.a: Flamingos, emperor penguins and ostriches are birds.
Ostriches and flamingos are great swimmers.
Penguins are very fast runners because of their long, strong legs.
